map.📚 尿流率(Qmax)正常参考器: 📚 Urine Flow Rate (Qmax) Normal Reference Tool
map.输入最大尿流率 Qmax 与排尿量，结合性别评估排尿功能与梗阻风险: Enter the maximum flow rate Qmax and voided volume to assess voiding function and obstruction risk according to sex
map.最大尿流率 Qmax 判读：男性 不低于15mL/s 正常、10 至 15 可疑: Interpreting maximum flow rate Qmax: in men not below 15 mL/s is normal, 10 to 15 suspicious, less than 10 obstructive; in women not below 20 is normal, 15 to 20 suspicious, less than 15 obstructive; when the voided volume is less than 150 mL the result is unreliable and must be repeated.
map.注：Qmax 受排尿量影响显著，需排尿量 ≥150 mL 结果才可靠；老年男性随: Note: Qmax is strongly affected by the voided volume, so a volume >= 150 mL is needed for a reliable result; in older men Qmax declines with age.
map.Qmax<10 mL/s（男）/<15 mL/s（女）提示梗阻或逼尿肌收缩力下降:
Qmax <10 mL/s in men or <15 mL/s in women suggests obstruction or reduced detrusor contractility, and further urodynamic testing is advised.
Causes of a reduced Qmax include BOO (bladder outlet obstruction) and DUA (detrusor underactivity), which urodynamics can differentiate.
map.⚠️ 尿流率为筛查性检查，结果需结合残余尿、症状等综合判断，不能单独作为手术指征: ⚠️ Uroflowmetry is a screening test; the result must be interpreted together with residual urine and symptoms, and cannot alone serve as an indication for surgery.
map.📚 深度解析：尿流率（Qmax）正常参考: 📚 Deep dive: urine flow rate (Qmax) normal reference
map.男性正常阈值≥15，12<15 提示尿流减弱，需结合 IPSS 与残余尿；若排尿: The male normal threshold is >= 15, so 12 < 15 indicates a weakened stream; interpret it together with IPSS and residual urine; if the voided volume is <150 mL, reliability is reduced.
map.女性正常阈值≥20，22≥20 属正常尿流率，无梗阻征象。: The female normal threshold is >= 20, so 22 >= 20 is a normal flow rate with no signs of obstruction.
map.Qmax 偏低就一定是梗阻吗？: Does a low Qmax always mean obstruction?
map.不一定，尿量<150mL、腹压排尿、前列腺增生或逼尿肌无力均可致 Qmax 下降: Not necessarily. A voided volume <150 mL, voiding by abdominal pressure, prostatic hyperplasia or detrusor weakness can all lower Qmax, so the curve and residual urine must be considered together.
map.老年男性 Qmax 略低如何解读？: How is a slightly low Qmax in older men interpreted?
map.≥60 岁男性 Qmax 生理性下降常见，若 10–15 且无症状可观察，<10: A physiological decline in Qmax is common in men aged >= 60 years; if it is 10-15 with no symptoms, observation is acceptable, while <10 warrants further testing.
map.关于「尿流率(Qmax)正常参考器」: About the Urine Flow Rate (Qmax) Normal Reference Tool
map.尿流率(Qmax)正常参考器 - 输入最大尿流率与排尿量，对照性别年龄评估是否存: Urine Flow Rate (Qmax) Normal Reference Tool - enter the maximum flow rate and voided volume to assess obstruction or suspicion against sex and age references. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
